title: Harden coordinator worker network mode safety
summary: Hardens Coordinator/Worker network-mode safety across launch blocking, watch folders, lifecycle dry-runs/mutations, route contracts, Tauri validation, WebView lifecycle dispatch, and worker override policy.
reason: Coordinator and worker modes must not accidentally start local remux/encode work through normal Launch, watch folders, stale settings, malformed settings, or frontend route drift.
behavior_before: Malformed NetworkRole values, string-like coordinator-local flags, stale watch settings, route duplication, and lifecycle provider/journal edge cases were not all covered by strict policy and regression tests.
behavior_after: Only standalone/empty roles allow normal Launch; unknown network roles block launch/watch launch; CoordinatorAlsoEncodeLocally is true only for Python True; watch reload failure degrades to no-launch; lifecycle dry-runs are no-journal/no-mutation; confirmed lifecycle routes require strict confirmation, provider success, strict journal evidence, and serialized state commit; frontend lifecycle dispatch resolves routes from backend contract metadata.
manual_validation: change_control validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed only for unrelated dependency-atlas assets: dependency_detail_core_library.{png,svg}, dependency_detail_desktop_watch.{png,svg}
unittest Local API/Tauri group: 131 tests - passed
unittest network helper group: 64 tests - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the touched backend policy/lifecycle/watch/contract/WebView/Tauri files and their tests, then rerun the listed unittest groups, node syntax checks, cargo check, and change-control validation.
notes:
Network-mode safety hardening pass for malformed roles, bool coercion, lifecycle dry-run/no-mutation, provider/journal fail-closed semantics, frontend route drift, and WorkerConfigOverrides disablement.
Hardens network role parsing, strict coordinator-local boolean handling, watch no-launch policy, lifecycle dry-run/no-journal behavior, provider/journal ordering, backend-disabled WorkerConfigOverrides, WebView contract-derived lifecycle dispatch, and Tauri route semantic validation.
Added generated summaries refreshed for touched files after validation.
Strict worktree coverage rerun leaves only unrelated dependency-atlas asset changes uncovered.
